# Troubleshooting

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `JOBS_INVALID_OPTION` | Bad option |
| `JOBS_INVALID_NAME` | Bad job name |
| `JOBS_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Payload over limit |
| `JOBS_JOB_NOT_FOUND` | Unknown id |
| `JOBS_INVALID_STATE` | Illegal transition |
| `JOBS_FORBIDDEN` | Admin denied |
| `JOBS_STALLED` | Lease expired |
| `JOBS_CANCELLED` | Cancelled |
